scope: Pure offline bound evaluation; excludes execution-driven training/selection and source-event instrumentation.
initial_direct_prior_location_runs: BOUND_PROFILE_1/2/3.json are also retained; final4/5/6 use the portable expected-results ZIP with the same preverification timing window.
timing_includes: Original bound transfers, path configuration, C summation, per-path summary construction and retained4833result rows; prepared path/candidate construction precedes timing.
timing_excludes: Python startup/import, input generation, execution simulation, native runs, training makespan selection, expected-results reading/comparison and serialization.
memory_includes: Python runtime, imported model, candidate/path inputs, all retained bound result rows; absolute Windows process peak, measured before expected-results load.
scaling: Direct enumeration O(candidates * sum_path(event_count * tracked_block_count)) with vector-expiry implementation, plus per-reference LRU-list costs for finite-way analysis. This three-path study uses at most8dedicated blocks, not state merging or a general CFG frontier.
larger_phase_scope: The domain-limited phase family is D^phases plus constants, so unrestricted phase enumeration is exponential; prune or limit candidate plans separately, and supply covered bounded paths.
